notes: Western Addition / Laurel Hill, sheet 2: institution grounds among ordinary blocks: St. Rose's Academy with the Convent of the Presentation (top, hatched), Masonic Cemetery (middle, hatched), Lowell High School (1196) and Andrew Jackson School (inside 1194), with ordinary blocks 1186-1212 and 1149-1176 (commercial strips on 1160, 1175, 1186, 1193-1195, 1210-1212). Judgment calls: (1) the Masonic Cemetery block is ONE block: the hatched cemetery, the unhatched wedge below its slanted south line (660-1015, 4895-4981) and the lots between Loyola, Hemway and Atalaya Terraces (1027-1334, 4873-4981) share printed lines and are bounded by streets only together; the terraces (x 1061-1078, 1144-1163, 1228-1246) are dead-end streets from the south. If the owner reads the terrace lots or the wedge as blocks of their own, strokes along the cemetery's south line are needed. (2) St. Rose's (to 4553) is likewise one block with the Convent's dashed outline (1200-1334, 4455-4553) and lot 1106 inside it; the Ewing Terrace loop road (top, about 1156-1272, 4400-4418) is street, with seeds in it; its south line's east end and the block's step at (1310-1333, 4452) are closed with strokes. (3) 1163's east side is printed dashed at x 1360-1361 with its north side stopping at 1349; read as the block's side and closed with a stroke. (4) the narrow outlined strip with NIDO AVE. lettering (1371-1446, to 4545) is read as a block, with the solid commercial piece at its west side (1363-1398, 4505-4545); 1112 is the L-shaped block (1463-1541 and 1541-1684 x 4492-4545) and 1113 the block inside its bend; the paper between them is street. (5) the dimension marks in the terraces of the 1145-1163 row (y about 4615-4625) stay attached to the block each touches (about 50-80 px each, labelled block). Strokes elsewhere close gaps in printed sides: 1146 W, 1147 N and E, 1148 N and E, 1161 E and S, 1150 W and S, 1159 W and N, 1160 N, 1149 E (cuts a corner mark), cemetery N at 903-919 and NE corner, rows 1212-1207 sides and bottoms. OWNER (2026-11-23), shown this crop: "You did the right thing, grouping it into one block, and you even labeled the little roads. Although the third road on the end is kind of floating in space, it should be attached to the road network." The print draws the block's bottom line (rows 4984-4987) straight across the mouth of Atalaya Terrace (x 1229-1245), and a width mark lies across the road on rows 4974-4977; the other two terraces have a gap. An opening over x 1230-1242, y 4973-4987 now lets the street through there, on his word.
